title: Quantum computing for neuroscience: opportunities beyond classical limits
title_zh: 量子计算在神经科学中的机遇：突破经典极限
abstract: Some of the least understood phenomena in the brain emerge from interactions between local and global brain states, yet representing their joint activity is a considerable computational challenge. As neuroscience datasets grow and classical methods reach their limits, alternative approaches are needed. Quantum computing, through its novel approach to information processing, may offer a solution.
abstract_zh: 大脑中一些最不为人理解的现象源于局部与全局脑状态之间的相互作用，但表征它们的联合活动是一项显著的计算挑战。随着神经科学数据集的增长和经典方法的局限性，需要替代方案。量子计算通过其对信息处理的新颖方法，可能提供解决方案。
